blur.$description: Pairs with backdrop.high.saturate for background effects

saturate.$description: Pairs with backdrop.high.blur for background effects

blur.$description: Pairs with backdrop.low.saturate for background effects

saturate.$description: Pairs with backdrop.low.blur for background effects

blur.$description: Pairs with backdrop.mid.saturate for background effects

saturate.$description: Pairs with backdrop.mid.blur for background effects

shadowHeadroom.$description: How many levels a surface's shadow level may exceed its surface level before the design system warns in development. The default is 2. Set it to 8 to turn the warning off. Production builds never warn.

1.$description: Shadow level 1: tight drop below level 2 (content container default). Same geometry series as 2-8.

2.$description: Content container elevation. Pairs with color.surface.level.2 and color.surface.edge.

3.$description: Popover and menu elevation. Pairs with color.surface.level.3.

6.$description: Shadow level 6: geometry of level 5 x1.5.

7.$description: Shadow level 7: geometry of level 5 x2.25.

8.$description: Shadow level 8: geometry of level 5 x3.375.

base.$description: Default stacking layer for normal page content.

behind.$description: Stacking layer for decorative elements that sit behind page content.

floatingHigh.$description: Stacking layer for popovers and menus above floating mid content. Pairs with z-index.floatingMid.

floatingMid.$description: Stacking layer for sticky headers and sidebars. Pairs with z-index.floatingHigh.

modal.$description: Stacking layer for dialogs and modals. Pairs with z-index.overlay.

overlay.$description: Stacking layer for backdrops that dim content behind a modal. Pairs with z-index.modal.

raised.$description: Stacking layer for content lifted slightly above the page, such as sticky table headers.

toast.$description: Top stacking layer for toasts, above dialogs and overlays.
